info.title: MJOLNIR Hub API
info.description: Open API for the MJOLNIR mod platform for Halo Campaign Evolved. Reads are public and unauthenticated. Browser sessions use Discord OAuth with an HttpOnly cookie; third-party tools will use scoped API keys (planned — see the roadmap in docs/hub_architecture.md).

avatar_url.description: Discord CDN avatar, when the user has one.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when exhausted.

type.description: Trust tier. `content` mods are inert game data and open to community upload. `script` (UE4SS Lua) and `native` (DLL) mods can execute code, so they ship exclusively from the mjolnir-core repository's reviewed, signed CI releases.

sha256.description: Hash of the release archive; verify after download.

build_min.description: Oldest game build this release is declared compatible with.

chunk_count.description: IoStore chunks this release claims, once scanned.

shared_chunks.description: How many IoStore chunk IDs both releases claim.

pairs.description: Every conflicting pair among the requested releases. Empty means the set installs cleanly in any order.

sample_chunk_ids.description: Up to 10 shared chunk IDs, hex-encoded 12-byte identifiers.

release_ids.description: Releases a client intends to install together.

url.description: Where the image is served from.

mine.description: The caller's own score, when signed in and rated.

author.description: Null when the comment was deleted.

get.description: Redirects the browser to Discord's consent screen. Pass `next` to return to a specific page after login.

500.description: OAuth is not configured on this deployment.

get.description: Discord redirects here; on success a session cookie is set.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Creates a draft `content` mod owned by the signed-in user. Script and native mods cannot be created here; they ship from the mjolnir-core repository's release pipeline.

get.summary: Published releases of a mod, newest first

201.description: The pending release; upload its archive next.

403.description: Not the owner, or not a content mod.

put.description: Raw zip bytes, at most 50 MiB. Re-uploading while pending or rejected replaces the archive and resets the release to pending.

200.description: Stored; call /complete to scan and publish.

post.summary: Scan the uploaded archive and publish or reject

200.description: Scan finished; status says whether it published.

409.description: No archive uploaded, or already decided.

get.summary: Published releases that claim any of the same chunks
get.description: Two content releases conflict exactly when their IoStore containers claim at least one chunk ID in common; whichever mounts later wins those chunks. Computed from the uploaded containers, not from author declarations.

post.summary: Conflict matrix for a set of releases
post.description: The endpoint mod managers integrate against: given the releases a profile intends to install, returns every pair that claims the same chunk. An empty list means any load order works.
multipart/form-data with `file` (png, jpeg or webp, ≤ 8 MiB) and `alt_text` (required — every image ships with a description).

400.description: Missing alt text or not an image.

put.description: One rating per user per mod; calling again replaces yours.

get.description: Flat list, oldest first; `parent_id` links replies. Clients assemble the tree.

delete.description: Author or moderator. Soft delete: the thread keeps its shape, the body is blanked.
